**In one line**: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman reportedly admitted that his oft-repeated predictions about when the company would hit its stated goal were "very wrong."

### Key points
- According to The Times of India, Altman said the timeline he has frequently cited turned out to be "very wrong."
- OpenAI's stated mission centers on building artificial general intelligence (AGI), so the remark is understood to concern when that milestone might arrive.
- The full context of his comments and any revised estimate should be verified against the original report.

### Why it matters
Timeline forecasts from AI leaders shape investment, regulation, and corporate roadmaps. A public admission of error from one of the field's most aggressive forecasters may signal a recalibration of the recently inflated expectations around AGI.
